description: A person's file (D7, S51 TM3 shape): the bug arrives UNVALIDATED — the schema carries no validation_state or priority_state from the caller (the store's default is the backstop; a crafted call cannot pre-label a claim). The priority a person decided may ride (known + a label); the validation stays unvalidated until the attempt runs (D1). There is NO filedBy param: filed_by is DERIVED from the stamped actor — a person at the socket files as 'person' (TM3; the old param let anyone name anyone). The result is the row as it now stands, the one the app and CLI both read.
